feature_schema.finite_checks: One to sixteen content tokens, exact text reconstruction, finite nonpositive logprobs, two distinct alternatives.
feature_schema.first_answer_top2_margin: Sorted top1 minus top2 server logprob at the first non-whitespace content token, including malformed text.
feature_schema.mean_token_nll: Negative mean of server logprob for every emitted content token, including whitespace and punctuation; no implicit EOS.
